digest: SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 bytes, lowercase hexadecimal
equivalence: Two operators are equivalent iff canonical complete transitions agree for every element of the finite declared operator domain.
witness_memory_quotient: Memory states are restricted to the three TaskInput keys occurring in W_L; all non-witness keys map to canonical bottom state ⊥. The quotient is exact for W_L because non-witness keys cannot be queried by a witness event.
